pages.title: Learning Window
pages.text: This page follows novel_cultivation_learn_requirements_waves.json, cultivation_methods.json, and manuals_catalog.json. The method catalog checks realm_min and realm_max_learn on the server. Passing the maximum only closes entry through that inheritance, while an invalid realm id is rejected.

pages.title: Prerequisites and Layers
pages.text: prerequisite_methods and prerequisite_realm_layers are active hard gates, while layers_required contributes to the method's own layer cap. A missing method or insufficient layer returns a specific failure. Learning starts at layer one and authored techniques unlock as it advances.

pages.title: Roots and Identity
pages.text: Active extended gates include spirit_roots.required_any tokens such as metal or wood, constitution or physique, race_required, and must_convert_after. faction and faction_relation_min check sect identity and outer, inner, or higher rank when the player already has membership.

pages.title: Conflict Matrix
pages.text: Passing catalog gates is followed by the method conflict matrix. Holding a manual cannot bypass mutually exclusive paths. Final learning, persistent flags, initial layer, and layer-based technique grants all remain server-authoritative.

pages.title: Technique Learn and Cast
pages.text: A technique checks its required realm, inferred sect hint, and requires_method. Casting also rechecks learned state, slot, cooldown, spiritual power, and executable effect, then applies authored high-tier reputation, region, or secret-realm gates. Technique-blocking statuses such as seal nascent also deny release.

pages.title: Honest Boundary
pages.text: Not every source field is one universal hard gate. Empty sect membership keeps the legacy manual path open. learn_source, items_suggested, requires_items, gender affinity, divine_sense_min, karma, and some social relations may remain descriptive or be handled by separate quest, sect, or reputation services.
